purpose: Complete static inventory of representation probes, companion interpretability probes, behavioral and system assessments, validation coverage, and saved assessment artifact families available in this repository.

included: The six P-series designs in research/representation_probes.md
All runnable probe CLIs and their probe-specific support modules
The companion J-space/J-lens probe implementation and research sweep
Runnable behavioral, comparison, environment, reward, and report assessments exposed by the repository
Research documents that contain durable assessments or experimental decisions
Saved probe, J-lens, evaluation, selection, and transcript artifact families
excluded: Training and data-generation commands unless they are direct dependencies of an assessment
Generic unit tests unrelated to probe or assessment implementations
Individual per-task transcript files and individual live checkpoint shards; their parent collections and counts or patterns are inventoried instead
Python bytecode caches, .DS_Store files, model weights, and adapter weights
scope.method: Static file discovery and inspection only. No probe, test, MLX import, model load, or model generation was run to create this manifest.

status_vocabulary.implemented: A runnable implementation exists for all material parts of the stated repository-level interface.
status_vocabulary.partially_implemented: A runnable implementation exists, but one or more design phases or controls are explicitly absent.
status_vocabulary.scaffold_only: Reusable infrastructure exists, but no end-to-end probe command exists.
status_vocabulary.planned_only: The method exists only in a research/design document.
status_vocabulary.complete_valid: A saved result completed its implemented protocol and is not invalidated by a known confound.
status_vocabulary.complete_partial_design: A saved result completed the implemented phases, but the implementation does not cover the full research design.
status_vocabulary.complete_invalid: Files are complete, but the repository records a methodological failure that prevents the result from supporting the intended conclusion.
status_vocabulary.partial: Some intermediate artifacts exist, but the expected final result set is absent.
status_vocabulary.in_progress_or_resumable_partial: Checkpoint artifacts exist and were observed changing during inventory; no final result set was present at the final-file check.

reference_specification.title: Representation probes: is the ceiling parameters or regimen?
reference_specification.relationship: Canonical design and decision-rule source for P1 through P6; companion to research/jspace_probe.md.
global_requirements: Use the model's own causal mask for every capture.
Report every probe with its control.
Write JSON and Markdown results under outputs/probes/<probe>/.
Interpret P2 using margin over the position-only baseline rather than raw accuracy.
Use mixed difficulties and recovery variants for corrected P2 data.

decision_grade_saved_p_series_results: P5 items 1-4 for adapters A/B/C; item 5 layer-block ablation is absent

representation_probe_alignment.name: Assistant axis before and after agentic post-training
implemented_components: Default-assistant and 24-role rollout generation
Strong multi-sentence in-character prompts
Optional one-shot role exemplars
Persisted rollout text before activation capture
Heuristic role-expression scoring and optional same-policy 0-3 judge
Filtering of non-expressive role responses
Per-layer axis construction from mean response-token residuals
PC1-alignment and split-half stability diagnostics
Per-turn trajectory position, drift, minimum, outcome, and failure-reason summaries
alignment_notes: The current source explicitly records that it implements only the measurement half of design section 4.

The current strong prompts, exemplars, rollout persistence, expression filter, and fail-closed role-count gate were engineered in direct response to the invalid first build documented in representation_probes.md.

saved_artifacts.reason: The one-line role prompts did not elicit role expression. PC1 alignment was 0.25-0.31 at middle layers versus the paper's >0.6 check, so the result measures prompt-format differences rather than persona.

saved_artifacts.composition: 96 default-assistant responses plus 8 responses for each of 24 roles; 12 roles used available exemplars.

saved_artifacts.notes: Contains the completed invalid base build followed by the start of a B build that was stopped.

representation_probe_alignment.name: Internal environment model via linear state probes
implemented_components: Generator-derived labels rather than labels parsed from notes
Residual capture at the last prompt token for configurable layers
Task-isolated train/test split
Ridge and multinomial/binary logistic probes
R2, MAE, accuracy, macro-F1, and AUC as appropriate
Shuffled-label controls
Position-only baseline keyed by family and step
Probe margin over the position-only baseline
Mixed train/p2mix/test difficulties and recovery variants
Leakage-free within-position analysis
Preflight rejection of insufficiently varying mixed designs
Intact-note and stripped-state-field conditions
Difficulty-stratified results
Per-task resumable checkpoint shards with artifact identity and task signatures
Bounded MLX cache and task-boundary cache reclamation
alignment_notes: The position baseline, mixed difficulties, recovery variants, and within-position analysis were engineered specifically to satisfy the two mandatory corrections added to design section 5 after the first confounded run.
A complete decision requires the intact-versus-stripped contrast for base and adapters, not a single raw-accuracy run.

saved_artifacts.reason: The train-only, fixed-difficulty design made state nearly deterministic from family and step. The activation scores cannot be interpreted as state decoding without the corrected position controls.

saved_artifacts.notes: Contains the completed confounded base capture/result and the beginning of a subsequent capture.

saved_artifacts.inventory_note: Checkpoint contents changed during static inventory, so the live shard count is intentionally not frozen here. The shards are resumable inputs, not a completed assessment.

probe_support_modules.role: Declares the P1/P2/P5 interpretability probe suite and its relationship to representation_probes.md.
Float32 causal residual capture, response-token means, activation injection, reversible LoRA layer masking, and task-state note stripping.
Refuses model loading while known evaluation/rollout commands occupy the GPU unless explicitly overridden.
Maps base/A/B/C policy names to the three agent-v2 best adapters or an explicit adapter directory.
Dependency-light ranks, Mann-Whitney U, AUC, accuracy, macro-F1, R2, and MAE used by the probes.

companion_jspace_probes.name: J-lens versus logit-lens at a deterministic expert decision
companion_jspace_probes.relationship_to_representation_spec: Explicit companion/predecessor. Supplies residual_at, jacobian_vector_product, jlens_map, readout, logit-lens controls, causal masking, and float32 numerical precedent used by P1, P2, and P5.

companion_jspace_probes.name: Paired matched-versus-mismatched J-lens ledger sweep
companion_jspace_probes.relationship_to_representation_spec: Companion mechanistic assessment supporting the P2 note-state hypothesis and supplying a positive-control precedent.

saved_artifacts.notes: Records the 42-case paired sign-test results and World A conclusion; the sweep script prints results and does not persist raw machine-readable rows.

broader_assessment_interfaces.purpose: Deterministic or sampled v2 policy evaluation with exact environment verdicts, clean/stress modes, action/schema/executable-call metrics, failure reasons, latency, token use, and full transcripts.
broader_assessment_interfaces.relationship_to_representation_spec: Supplies held-out behavior, failure labels, stored trajectories, and causal outcome metrics required by P1, P3, P5 ablation, and P6.

broader_assessment_interfaces.purpose: Screens saved checkpoints on held-out validation behavior and selects by success, clean rate, valid-action rate, then later step.
broader_assessment_interfaces.relationship_to_representation_spec: Provides the selected A/B/C policy artifacts used by all P-series comparisons.

broader_assessment_interfaces.purpose: Aggregates evaluation JSON summaries into a cross-run table.
Evaluates the earlier native-tool-call agent task suite for base or adapter policies.
Compares base, earlier agent adapter, and depth-expanded policy on the long-horizon suite.
Prints base-versus-adapter action traces for one legacy agent task.
Interactive or one-prompt base-versus-adapter chat comparison, with optional tool schemas.
Reports Python, macOS, memory, MLX device, an MLX compute smoke test, and installed package versions.
Inspects exact, numeric, format, conciseness, and combined reward components for a supplied or example response.

standalone_system_assessments.purpose: Requires cached and uncached greedy trajectories to have identical raw text, actions, and verdicts, while reporting speedup.
standalone_system_assessments.saved_result: research/agentic_paradigm.md records 6/6 identical and 37 percent faster; no standalone raw output file is present.
